host_processor_core_count: 60 (cores exposed to the VM per socket; SMT disabled)
host_processor_frequency: 2.3 GHz base / 3.9 GHz max turbo (public Intel Xeon 6776P specification)
host_processor_caches: L1d 48 KB + L1i 64 KB per core, L2 2 MB per core, L3 336 MB per socket
host_memory_capacity: 2907 GB usable per node (Crusoe instance-type spec `b300-288gb-sxm-ib-noht.8x` lists 2954 GB nominal; variance is firmware/reserved-memory overhead)
host_storage_capacity: Shared NFS from Crusoe managed storage: /data 500 TB (datasets, checkpoints, images, logs), /home 300 TB; VM boot disk local
host_networking: 8x InfiniBand XDR HCAs per node at 800 Gb/s each (mlx5_5-mlx5_12), one rail per GPU; plus 5 lower-rate CAs (mlx5_0-3 at 100 Gb/s, mlx5_4 at 200 Gb/s) used for management/storage, and an Ethernet NIC (ens7) for NCCL socket bootstrap (NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=ens7)
host_networking_topology: Rail-optimized InfiniBand fabric (8 rails); IB SHARP/CollNet enabled; NVLink SHARP (NVLS) per-benchmark (see configs/<benchmark>/ENV.md)
host_memory_configuration: DDR5 (host DIMM configuration not visible from inside the VM)
accelerator_frequency: 2032 MHz max SM clock, 3996 MHz max memory clock
accelerator_interconnect: 18x NVLink 5 per GPU (NV18 all-to-all across the 8 GPUs per `nvidia-smi topo -m`; `nvidia-smi nvlink -s` reports 18 links at 53.125 GB/s each)
accelerator_interconnect_topology: Single 8-GPU NVLink domain per node; Nodes interconnected via InfiniBand only (no NVLink between nodes)
hw_notes: Virtualized instances (Crusoe Cloud b300-288gb-sxm-ib.8x family, cloud-hypervisor/KVM). GPU product string 'NVIDIA B300 SXM6 PC' confirmed via nvidia-smi on every node used. 120 vCPUs per node with SMT disabled. Driver 580.167.08, VBIOS 97.10.64.00.0A, identical across all nodes.
framework: NVIDIA NeMo Framework (Megatron-Bridge), built on NGC PyTorch 26.04 container (nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.04-py3)

other_software_stack.cuda_driver_version: 595.58.03 (CUDA forward-compatibility package inside the container); host kernel driver 580.167.08
other_software_stack.pytorch_version: As bundled in nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.04-py3 (not independently captured)

sw_notes: CUDA/NCCL/cuBLAS/cuDNN/TensorRT/DALI/OpenMPI/PyTorch versions above were captured from the training container and host at run time; not independently re-checked per benchmark.
